headline: ExxonMobil Reports Third-Quarter Profit of $15.4 Billion
summary: ExxonMobil reported a third-quarter profit of $15.4 billion, more than double its earnings from a year earlier, driven by full-capacity Gulf Coast refineries and strong diesel prices.
why: ExxonMobil is one of the world's largest publicly traded international energy companies, serving as a primary bellwether for the oil and gas sector and broader energy commodities markets.

impacts.name: Exxon Mobil Corp
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected earnings and profits beating Wall Street estimates directly benefit the company's financial standing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: ExxonMobil's adjusted earnings per share of $4.23 beat Wall Street's $4.08 estimate, driven by high refining capacity and diesel prices, which tends to increase investor demand for the stock.
